intro: Entho Sundarudamma Thanu is the latest Telugu Christian song written by M. Prasanth Raju, sung by K. Parishuddarao and music composed by Surendra Chinni. This song was released on June 16, 2026, through YESAYYA SONGS YouTube Channel.
